name: AnimatedSwitcher
description: A widget that automatically transitions from an old child to a new child using a fade, scale, slide, or custom transition. Useful for smooth swapping of widgets with animation.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display. When this changes, AnimatedSwitcher animates from the old child to the new child.
properties.possible_values: Any widget. Must provide a unique Key to differentiate between children.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate the transition between old and new children.

properties.name: transitionBuilder
properties.description: Defines how the old child transitions out and the new child transitions in.
properties.possible_values: Any function returning a Widget. Can use FadeTransition, ScaleTransition, SlideTransition, etc.

properties.name: layoutBuilder
properties.description: Defines how to lay out the new child and the outgoing children during the transition.

properties.name: reverseDuration
properties.description: The duration to use for the reverse animation when switching back to a previous child.

properties.name: switchInCurve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when the new child appears.

properties.name: switchOutCurve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when the old child disappears.
